New or Unfinished Business by Board Members

All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar, are considered to be simple or routine by the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency Board of Directors and will be acted upon by a single vote

Adopting a Resolution of Local Support as required by the Metropolitan Transportation Commission (MTC) to add a project to the federal Transportation Improvement Program and program $3,400,000 of federal One Bay Area Grant 2 (OBAG2) funds awarded under the MTC’s Housing Incentive Pool program to the SFMTA’s Lincoln Way Signals project for construction.
